discovery_notes: Search budget (shared 200/turn) ran out after ~26 searches, before August/September detail and second sources for Apr-Jul. All evidence is fan/news search snippets; no official DLP page surfaced. Naming conflicts recorded (Tarot vs Collector's Card; Voyage vs Travel; Lumiere partner Babette/Fifi/Plumette; LE 800 vs 1000; several date conflicts). Unattributed (mixed-summary) items not claimed: Jan 1 2026 OE design series, Jan 7 Pieces Jaunes Mickey OE, Feb 28 WoF jumbo EUR60, Aug 21 PTT at Disney Sequoia Lodge, Apr Main Street station stained glass pins. Whatnot resale listing (Bruno LE 800) ignored as marketplace. No prompt-injection content seen. Brush of Magic/Animated Cuties/Windows of Attraction skipped.
